lens: Skeptic, geometry first. The w44a/w45a scripts did not survive, so I rebuilt them in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/2fb1f2ef-fbd7-5fb9-b7d2-14a3db7265c8/scratchpad/raterA46 from the boxes described in w45a. c17.py is the q17 cover rows: x 660-800, y 110-160 step 10, mask B/R<1.6 and 80<L<230. It reproduces w45's render rows (59 52 43 41 37 40 against 58 52 43 41 37 40), which also confirms the geometry is unchanged. Its photo rows are 55 49 57 63 76 55 against 60 53 61 63 77 56 before (a resample difference). w.py is the q15 head-on cover run. t.py samples strap hue. tm/tc.py count teal strap pixels, now also as 'solid' pixels after a 3x3 morphological opening, because a mask overlay (mask.png) showed the old whole-image teal count was mostly photo fabric fleck. cam.js renders q17 with 6 alternative cameras from b46/test.html (c0 = the official camera, reproducing q17; c1-c5 are variants) to split camera from geometry. Crops: z17strap.png, z17head.png, heads_c2c4ph.png, arm_zoom.png, cams.png, mask.png / mask2.png / mask3.png.
calibrationNote: Up 0.05 from 8.4. The detail mean is 8.28 (w45 8.28). The candidate changes only the strap colours, and q17 cover rows and q15 widths reproduce w45 to within 1 px. The tongue-strap hue is now on the photo: in q17 G/R is 1.81-1.84, B/G 1.46-1.47 and L 116-117, against y_47303's 1.83-1.88, 1.52-1.53 and 118-125 (w45: 2.35 / 1.47 / 96). Two of my earlier findings were measurement problems, and I retract them here. (1) 'Straps at 43 % of the photo's pixels' came from a teal mask that counted photo fabric flecks. After a morphological opening, the render has 1670-1718 solid teal px in q17 against 837-1161 in y_47303, and 1177-1183 in q16 against 361-719. Strap presence is not short. (2) The q17 headrest mismatch is almost all camera. With a higher, more frontal camera (c4: eye 0.6 / 1.65 / 49.0, yaw -pi/2+0.05, pitch -0.5) the near cover reads as a broad flap: 91 x 93 px, area 3903, #7e85ab L144, against the photo's 86 x 108 px, area 4237, #7c8aaf L146. The remaining geometry gap is about 14 % less flap height. One new finding on unchanged geometry pulls the other way: in q17 and in every frontal variant, each inter-seat arm shows a dark-grey lower plate (L83) under a puffy white arm. y_47303 shows a single slim cool-grey cap (L180-200, B/R 1.13-1.16) with nothing dark beneath. Not 8.5 yet: the arm plate, the belt form (flat stripes, white plastic latch, a boxy drape), the flat pillow, back F +23 L and cover F +14 L in q15, and the q17 camera itself.

priorIssues.note: The official q17 rows are unchanged at 59 52 43 41 37 40 (photo 55 49 57 63 76 55). The camera experiment shows the cause is the view, not the model. At c4 the near flap is 91 x 93 px, area 3903 and L144, against the photo's 86 x 108, 4237 and L146; c2 gives 104 x 88, area 4600. In heads_c2c4ph.png all three near headrests read like y_47303. At the official camera the cover is seen almost edge-on: the front-to-side face ratio is about 0.2, where the photo's is about 4. I estimate the official camera at 30 degrees or more more edge-on, and about 0.3 m lower than y_47303, which is worse than the 20 degrees the brief assumed. Split: roughly 85-90 % camera and 10-15 % geometry (the flap is about 14 % short). The q15 head-on run is unchanged: E 73 px against 71.

priorIssues.status: fixed (in scene); studio check not met
priorIssues.note: t.py strap boxes in q17: #3f73a9 G/R 1.81, B/G 1.47, L116 and #3f74aa 1.84 / 1.46 / 117, against y_47303 #4279ba 1.83 / 1.53 / 125 and #3d74b0 1.88 / 1.52 / 118. That is inside my w45 target band (L sits 1-2 above 115, but still below the photo). The studio e11 / e7 tongue is #88bfde, B/G 1.16, L184: still a pale sky-blue under flat studio light, short of the B/G >= 1.35 studio check. Low priority, because the scene matches.

priorIssues.status: partly fixed (coverage claim retracted; drape not fixed)
priorIssues.note: Coverage: solid teal px are 1670 in q17 and 1177 in q16, against the photo's 837 and 361. With a looser mask they are 1718 / 1183 against 1161 / 719. The old 3785 / 3771 photo counts were fabric fleck (mask.png), so the render is not short of strap. The form is not fixed. e11 still shows a rectangular navy drape box, #313c69, with a horizontal seam. The latch is a neutral white block (#e6e7e8, B/R 1.01, L232), where y_47303's latch is cool steel (#93a5bf, B/R 1.16, L168). In y_47303 the teal tongue hangs from the cushion gap with metal hardware; in the render the teal is a flat stripe lying on the pan (z17strap.png).

Re-measured with rebuilt boxes (x 490-590 for F). Back F is L101, B/R 1.88, against 78 / 1.98 (w45 box: 90 vs 70); D 100 vs 104, E 64 vs 69, G 63 vs 62. Cover F is L58 against 44 (w45 56 vs 44); cover E is 60 against 52. In my 505-585 x 430-480 box the pillow E p90/p10 is 2.09 against 2.02, so the earlier 1.33 used a tighter interior box. Visually it is still a flat rectangle, where y_47300's pillows are plump, with puffed corners and a crease, and lean forward onto the pan. The tongue tips are still visible on each pan, but y_47300 shows small grey latch bits at similar spots, so this is minor.
The candidate touches strap colours only, and the q17 rows reproduce. At the official q17 camera the cover strip still reads pale and neutral.

details.refs: Back D L100 / B/R 1.90 against 104 / 1.88. Back F L101 against 78 is still too light (w45a-4).
Backs E / G L64 / 63, B/R 2.21, against 69 / 62 and 2.25 / 2.32.

At c4 / c2 the cover is 91 x 93 / 104 x 88 px with L144, against the photo's 86 x 108 and L146. The official q17 rows (59 52 43 41 37 40) are a camera artefact. The flap is about 14 % short. Head-on E is 73 px against 71. Cover F L58 against 44.
Unchanged: a flat rectangle where the photo shows a plump, leaning cushion. The side-block question is still open.

New measurement on unchanged geometry (arm_zoom.png). In q17 and c4, a dark-grey plate (#474e63, L83) shows under every inter-seat arm. y_47303 has none. Dark-neutral px in the seat zone: q17 2530, c4 1582, photo 896. The arm cap is near-white and neutral (#acadb1, B/R 1.03), where the photo's is cool satin grey (#a8b2bf-#bac6d7, B/R 1.13-1.16). The arm reads about 1.7x thicker relative to the photo, partly because the camera is lower.

Hue is on the photo in the scene: G/R 1.81-1.84, B/G 1.46, L116-117, against 1.83-1.88 / 1.52 / 118-125. Presence is fine (solid teal px 1670 vs 837-1161). Short of 8.5+ because of form: flat stripes on the pan, a white plastic latch block against the photo's steel #93a5bf, and a boxy drape with a seam.

issues.title: q17 camera is ~30 deg too edge-on and ~0.3 m low; with it fixed the headrest cover matches
issues.evidence: cams.png / heads_c2c4ph.png. At official q17 the cover's front:side face ratio is about 0.2, against about 4 in y_47303. At c4 (eye [0.6, 1.65, 49.0], yaw -pi/2+0.05, pitch -0.5) the near flap is 91 x 93 px, L144, against 86 x 108, L146. Global luma correlation alone is a poor guide (c0 0.549, c4 0.495): it rewards the wall and windows, not the seats.
issues.fix: Start the camera search from c4 / c2. Score it on the near-headrest flap area and aspect, plus the arm-cap positions, instead of whole-frame luma.
issues.check: Near flap area 3800-4600 px with height/width >= 1.0, and q17 cover rows >= 50 in 4 of 6.

issues.title: Dark-grey lower plate shows under every inter-seat arm in side views; arm cap is too white and puffy
issues.evidence: arm_zoom.png: the ECON_PLATE loft in 09a_econ.js (non-end arms, y 0.48-0.54) renders #474e63, L83 as a second bar under each arm in q17 and c4. y_47303's inter-seat arms are one slim satin cap (#a8b2bf-#bac6d7, B/R 1.13-1.16, L180-200) with cushion visible beneath. Dark-neutral px in the seat zone: 2530 (q17) and 1582 (c4) against 896. The plate was added for y_47300 head-on (w31), where the arm hides most of it.
issues.fix: Keep it head-on but hide it from the side: drop the non-end plate 3-4 cm (y 0.44-0.50) so the pan bolsters occlude it, or shorten its z extent to the rear 8 cm. Give SEATMAT.arm a slight cool tint (about #c9d0da) and trim the arm's mid-section height by about 15 %.
issues.check: q17 seat-zone dark-neutral px <= 1500; no grey bar under the near-row arms; arm cap B/R 1.10-1.18.

issues.title: Belt hardware and drape: white plastic latch, boxy seamed drape, teal lying flat
issues.evidence: e11 latch #e6e7e8 (B/R 1.01, L232) against y_47303's steel #93a5bf (B/R 1.16, L168). The drape is a rectangular box with a seam. In the photo the teal tongue strap hangs from the cushion gap. The studio tongue is #88bfde, B/G 1.16.
issues.fix: Latch to a metal #9aa6b8, r 0.3. Give the drape the strap's own width and material with a 2-3 segment bend. Optionally hang a 4-5 cm vertical teal segment at the anchor.
issues.check: Latch B/R 1.1-1.2 and L 150-185 in q17; no seam in e11.

issues.title: Carried: q15 back F tick too light, cover F too light, pillows are flat rectangles
issues.evidence: Back F L101 against 78; cover F L58 against 44 (E 60 against 52); in y_47300 the pillows are plump with puffed corners and lean onto the pan.
issues.fix: Lower the gain or base on the F tick back tile by about 20 %, darken the cover F variant, and bow the pillow faces 1-1.5 cm with pinched corners.
issues.check: Back F L 72-85; cover F L <= 50.
